116-280-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
116-280-2645-3430.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1278-3327-4508-6797.easyPrerequisites: Lightning-Rig Crew doesn't have summoning sickness.
1278-3327-4508-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1278-3327-4508-6797.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} due to its cost reduction, including its commander tax.
Lightning-Rig Crew triggers, untapping it.
Resolve Dargo. Then, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

512-950-7066.easyPrerequisites: Avatar Kyoshi and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-950-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Avatar Kyoshi, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-950-7066.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Avatar Kyoshi's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7297-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
3259-7297-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7297-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2511-4986-7896--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Mirkwood Nurturer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mirkwood Nurturer enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Mirkwood Nurturer
Repeat.
2511-4986-7896--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

1580-2921-4871-4976.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-2946-4871-6255.notablePrerequisites:
A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
You have max speed.
997-2946-4871-6255.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4499-4872-7722.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Emiel the Blessed.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Warp from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2438-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-2438-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-4496-4616-5220.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life and draw a card.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4068-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4068-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one Mountain.
4068-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

3499-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
3499-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3499-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

774-4543-6664.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}.
774-4543-6664.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trench Behemoth twice by returning two lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting both lands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7278-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7278-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

369-2511-2730.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1849-3899-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

4488-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with two or more charge counters on it

512-2593-4241.description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Halo Fountain and Astral Cornucopia to become a creature.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Astral Cornucopia, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
512-2593-4241.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

826-3053-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites:
There are at least three basic land types among lands you control.
Trazyn the Infinite and Amoeboid Changeling do not have summoning sickness.
826-3053-3767-3918.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1737-4242-4853-5256.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, Su-Chi and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling target player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1069-1251-3228-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1251-3228-5499.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Soldier.
Activate the Soldier by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-1469-2459-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Court of Vantress trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Court of Vantress.
Repeat.

2103-4863-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Revolutionist each turn.
2103-4863-6122.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Revolutionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2511-5663--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2511-5663--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1987-2792-4125.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-2792-4125.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Great Whale.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

2034-3490-3880.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-3490-3880.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Ravenous Squirrel, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ravenous Squirrel.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2066-2872-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Clever Conjurer.
Fertile Ground attached to a land you control.
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
2066-2872-3525.description:
Activate the land with Fertile Ground attached, adding at least {1}.
Fertile Ground triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.

1495-1656-4899.notablePrerequisites: The combined mana value of cards in your library is greater than or equal to the sum of your opponents' life totals.
1495-1656-4899.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Phyrexian Devourer's ability by exiling the top card of your library, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Necrotic Ooze equal to the card's mana value.
Repeat step 1 until the number of +1/+1 counters on Necrotic Ooze is at least equal to the sum of your opponents' life totals.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 until all opponents have taken lethal damage.
